newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were quietly steady in moderate trade, dealer said on Wednesday.

They said most traders were sidelined ahead of tonight's release of the U.S. April durable goods figures, which are forecast to show an increase of 1.3 percent compared with a 2.6 percent fall reported in March.
"The market was pretty quiet in the morning. Markets are short of lenders, the problem is looking for funds. However, the terms are still quite steady," a local dealer said.
In day-to-day rates, Wednesday/Thursday, Thursday/Friday and week-fixed were unchanged from Tuesday's common 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent, respectively.

Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged from Tuesday's 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-13/16 5-11/16, nine-months eased 1/8 percentage point to 6-1/16 5-15/16 and twelve-months was unchanged at 6-3/16 6-1/16 percent.
